main_failure_modes: broad insider buys dilute signal quality versus narrow watchlist names; lift stays immaterial; single-ticker concentration breaches guard; broad event tickers thin in warehouse prices
prediction.confidence_reason: Prior narrow replay was consistently positive but immaterial purely on sample of 234 buys across 49 names. The broad historical sample gives roughly 16x more open-market buys across 611 names, so a genuine insider-buy edge should now clear the materiality bar; the main risk is breadth diluting per-event quality.

calibration.realized_failure_mode: edge did not generalize to broad universe; narrow-watchlist positivity was a small-sample artifact
calibration.surprise_note: Pre-run p=0.40. On broad data the sleeve was not merely immaterial but slightly PnL-negative (-$930, -0.40%) with 1/3 EV-window regression, despite passing sample (33 trades) and concentration (single-ticker share 0.165) guards. The breadth removed the positivity rather than just failing to reach materiality, so the prior 'positive but underpowered' read was a narrow-sample artifact.
